name: cc-grammar-coach
description: The cc-grammar-coach plugin: an out-of-band English grammar checker with mistake-driven drill, learn, and progress skills feeding a local dashboard, installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: cc-grammar-coach
plugins.description: Out-of-band English grammar checker (UserPromptSubmit hook) that logs your mistakes and shows optional statusline feedback, plus drill, learn, and progress skills that feed a local dashboard with lesson-and-quiz sessions and a mistake-frequency chart.
